Thus product likelihood signs switch exactly across u+v=1, fixing the essential-unique maximizing triangle. Direct cosine integrals give the absolutely convergent odd-k/even-l series. First exponents 1,5,9 imply the long-time remainder; reflected-image coupling and the sum of two absolute N(0,2t) variables give the precise 8*Phi(-1/(2sqrt t)) small-time deficit and smaller e^[-1/(4t)] reflection error. Boundary starts have positive continuous kernels for t>0. This reconstructs an all-time proof; sampling cannot prove TP2 or asymptotics.
